name: Field
description: Owns the label, description and error for one form control.

name.description: Field name, used for error distribution from Form

disabled.description: Disables the field: dimmed once, and its control cannot be used

invalid.description: Marks the field invalid: the control takes the danger edge and Field.Error shows

validate.description: Custom validation function returning error string(s) or null

validationDebounceTime.description: Debounce time in ms for onChange validation

when: Any labelled Input, Textarea, Select, Combobox or NumberField
One error message per failure reason, not one catch-all
A custom control needs a real label and description
Server errors must land on the field that caused them
whenNot: Naming a group of controls (use Fieldset)
A control with no visible label, such as a toolbar filter (give the control an aria-label)
guidelines: Input, Textarea, Select, Combobox and NumberField join the field as direct children
Wrap a custom control in Field.Control so it joins the field context
Give each Field.Error a match so the message fits the failure; with no children it shows the browser's message
Nest inside Form to route server errors by field name
accessibility: Field.Error is an alert with an icon, so the failure never relies on colour alone
data-disabled and data-invalid are available for styling

examples.name: Single field
examples.description: Label, control and description wired together.
examples.code:
<Field name="email">
  <Field.Label>Email address</Field.Label>
  <Input type="email" placeholder="jane@example.com" />
  <Field.Description>We will never share your email.</Field.Description>
</Field>

examples.name: Two-column layout
examples.description: Grid places two short fields side by side and one full-width.
examples.code:
<Grid columns={2} gap="md">
  <Field name="firstName">
    <Field.Label>First Name</Field.Label>
    <Input placeholder="Jane" />
  </Field>
  <Field name="lastName">
    <Field.Label>Last Name</Field.Label>
    <Input placeholder="Doe" />
  </Field>
  <Grid.Item colSpan="full">
    <Field name="email">
      <Field.Label>Email</Field.Label>
      <Input type="email" placeholder="jane@example.com" />
      <Field.Error match="typeMismatch">Enter a valid email address</Field.Error>
    </Field>
  </Grid.Item>
</Grid>

examples.name: Invalid
examples.description: invalid marks the field failed and reveals Field.Error.
examples.code:
<Field name="username" invalid>
  <Field.Label>Username</Field.Label>
  <Input defaultValue="ada lovelace" />
  <Field.Error match>Usernames cannot contain spaces</Field.Error>
</Field>

examples.name: Select in a Field
examples.description: The trigger takes the label; the error lands under it.
examples.code:
<Field name="team" invalid>
  <Field.Label>Team</Field.Label>
  <Select placeholder="Choose a team">
    <Select.Trigger />
    <Select.Content>
      <Select.Item value="design">Design</Select.Item>
      <Select.Item value="engineering">Engineering</Select.Item>
    </Select.Content>
  </Select>
  <Field.Error match>Choose a team.</Field.Error>
</Field>

examples.name: Custom validation
examples.description: validate runs on change and feeds Field.Error.
examples.code:
<Field
  name="age"
  validate={(value) => {
    const num = Number(value);
    if (isNaN(num) || num < 18) return 'Must be 18 or older';
    return null;
  }}
  validationMode="onChange"
  validationDebounceTime={500}
>
  <Field.Label>Age</Field.Label>
  <Input type="number" placeholder="18" />
  <Field.Description>You must be at least 18 years old.</Field.Description>
  <Field.Error match="customError" />
</Field>

relations.note: Input, Textarea, Select, Combobox and NumberField take their label from Field
Wrap in Form for server-side error distribution
Use Fieldset to group related fields

propsSummary: name: string - field name for error distribution
invalid: boolean - danger edge on the control and Field.Error shown
Kit controls join as direct children; Field.Control wraps a custom control
Field.Error match: valueMissing|typeMismatch|customError|... - granular errors; no children shows the browser message
